tasks.prompt: In the project tracker, mark the 'Add biometric unlock' task as done.

assertions.name: biometric task is done
assertions.sql: SELECT status FROM tasks WHERE id=2

assertions.name: task was assigned first (ERR_409 quirk)
assertions.sql: SELECT assignee_id FROM tasks WHERE id=2

assertions.name: assigned to an active user
assertions.sql: SELECT u.active FROM tasks t JOIN users u ON u.id=t.assignee_id WHERE t.id=2

tasks.prompt: Find the task about the warehouse sync that keeps timing out and set its status to in_progress.

assertions.name: the ETL/warehouse task (id 5) is in_progress
assertions.sql: SELECT status FROM tasks WHERE id=5

assertions.name: no wrong task got moved to in_progress
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status='in_progress' AND id NOT IN (1,5,7,9)

tasks.prompt: Create a new high-priority task titled 'Patch CVE-2026-1234' in the Data Platform project.

assertions.name: task created in Data Platform (project 2) with high priority
assertions.sql: SELECT priority FROM tasks WHERE title='Patch CVE-2026-1234' AND project_id=2

assertions.name: exactly one such task (no duplicate/retry mess)
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE title='Patch CVE-2026-1234'

tasks.prompt: Assign every unassigned task in the Mobile App project to Priya Raman.

assertions.name: the three unassigned MOB tasks now belong to Priya (user 1)
assertions.sql: SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE project_id=1 AND assignee_id=1 ORDER BY id

assertions.name: no MOB task left unassigned
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE project_id=1 AND assignee_id IS NULL

assertions.name: did not disturb already-assigned MOB tasks
assertions.sql: SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE project_id=1 AND assignee_id=2 ORDER BY id
